posts.author: Eternidade_1
posts.body:
M5D - Dia 7 ✔
https://eternidade1.blogspot.com/2024/12/m5d-dia-7.html
Graphics and design.
Since the changes in the monitor affected my habits, I decided to invest time in organizing the resources.
I actually stored the resources in different places in the cloud, I noticed that some hosting sites delete the content over time.
Spending time away from the project makes things very confusing, so it's better to go slowly.
Game systems
The systems have been redesigned, with greater player customization and greater integration with the scenario.
This new system will be a bit exhausting to add, mainly because the player will be able to choose where to equip their skill and what level they want to use, since there are 4 fighting styles or slot sessions, the system needs to check where the skill is and whether it is already equipped or not.
It will be something new, it didn't work like that before, the player chose the fighting mode and equipped the skill, and it would enter the maximum level available.
The entire character profile structure has been changed. This means more screens related to the character and the group of characters.
Game AI
I think it will be responsible for guiding the player throughout the game, based on their gameplay and choices, but for that I have to establish the story arcs within the game.
Story arcs
These are the main themes that drive the game. Action, horror, tragedy and adventure respectively.
Holy wars: This is a cosmic event that basically affects the entire universe, it is a type of Battle Royale of the Gods, who compete for a title. This is where the story takes place, these events mobilize the entire universe.
Soulless: Monsters that are all over the universe and can appear at any time, divided between inferior and superior, their origin is linked to the removal of a character's soul. Although they are a problem, there are ways to avoid them, and the confrontation against these entities is always very organized and at the appropriate level.
Soul: Souls are the reason for power, the more souls you have, the more power you have. Souls are used to evolve the character or exchange this XP for money. Not everyone consumes souls, they are stored in specific places. Each soul is different from the other and this can cause great confusion in the universe.
Universe: The universe is extensive, with countless maps, planets, moons, nations, structures, routes, terrains, etc. Even if I don't have enough space to detail everything, I can at least put this information in the game.
